**[Recall Knowledge - Fey](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10)): DC 20 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 18 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 15 [Cultist Troop](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2712) **Source** [Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm](/Sources.aspx?ID=209) pg. 19 **Perception** +15; [low-light vision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=23) **Languages** **Skills** [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +14 **Str** +5 **Dex** +1 **Con** +4 **Int** +1 **Wis** +0 **Cha** +3 --- **AC** 21 **Fort** +15 **Ref** +12 **Will** +11 **HP** 90 (16 squares) Weaknesses area damage 5, [cold iron](/Equipment.aspx?ID=375) 5, [splash](/Traits.aspx?ID=150) damage 2
**[Troop Defenses](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=44)** --- **Speed** 25 feet; troop movement **[Form Up](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=43)** **Troop Movement** Whenever a troop Strides, it first Forms Up as a free action to condense into a 20-foot-by–20-foot area (minus any missing squares), then moves up to its Speed. **Wild Swing** **Frequency** once per round; **Effect** The cultists chaotically swing their weapons—from pixies' tiny rapiers to redcaps' scythes—at each enemy adjacent to the troop (DC 22 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save), dealing a small amount of damage to the troop at the same time. The damage depends on the number of actions.
1d12+1 slashing damage to enemies and 1d4 slashing damage to the troop
2d12+1 slashing damage and 1d4+2 slashing damage to the troop
2d12+5 slashing damage and 2d4 slashing damage to the troop
